evidenceBoundary.rule: Rendered screenshots establish the visual fact; visible DOM and computed values validate the narrow semantic role. Aggregate palettes, CSS variable names and Dembrandt output remain candidates until a rendered claim validates them.

brandThesis: DangoUI presents a pragmatic technical system through a quiet white documentation canvas, strong black information hierarchy, restrained lavender navigation feedback and compact component-scale controls. Its identity comes from clear system structure and precise role separation, not from a loud global brand wash.

invariants.fact: The frozen documentation pages are predominantly white with black typography and low-emphasis supporting surfaces.
invariants.interpretation: Information architecture carries more identity than decorative imagery.
invariants.recommendation: Keep the reading canvas quiet and use contrast for hierarchy before adding decoration.

invariants.fact: The documentation current-page cue uses rgb(88, 84, 255), while the frozen Primary Button uses rgb(124, 102, 255).
invariants.interpretation: The two purple values have different observed jobs and are not interchangeable palette swatches.
invariants.recommendation: Map each purple only to its validated role; do not collapse them into one universal accent without new evidence.

invariants.fact: At 390px the sidebars disappear and the article occupies a single inset column while typography remains readable.
invariants.interpretation: The shell changes structure at narrow widths rather than scaling the desktop composition as a picture.
invariants.recommendation: Preserve reading order and hierarchy while removing secondary navigation columns on phone.

invariants.fact: The Button page presents live controls beside code in a technical preview/code structure.
invariants.interpretation: Component proof favors implementation clarity over promotional card composition.
invariants.recommendation: Keep component examples explicit, inspectable and subordinate to the documentation hierarchy.

invariants.fact: The frozen Button main column is 4186.765625px tall and its verified reading order includes title, purpose, import, examples, API and theme variables.
invariants.interpretation: A DangoUI component reference is a multi-module technical document; one isolated control example cannot stand in for the page's reference density.
invariants.recommendation: Preserve at least two independently reviewable Button-page sections and retain the progression from usage context through live preview/code to reference material.

invariants.fact: The mobile evidence separately observes a full-width 390px header and a 358px inset article inside the 390px viewport.
invariants.interpretation: Single-column reflow is a relationship between distinct header and reading-column layers; the entire screenshot is not a layer.
invariants.recommendation: Record bounded source and Demo regions for the mobile utility header and inset reading column. Reject [0,0,1,1] as layer-level proof.

invariants.fact: The frozen Evidence establishes the Button main reading column and its ordered modules, but the frozen goal contains no mayTranslate authorization for aspect, crop, or asset-variant replacement.
invariants.interpretation: A calibration run label is not a visual variant, and responsive implementation alone does not authorize a materially different comparison crop.
invariants.recommendation: Use stable variant multi-module-preview-code-api-theme on both source and Demo. Compare like-for-like bounded regions at the same normalized aspect; otherwise return to Demo rather than inventing crop permission.

semanticClaims.meaning: The normal Primary Button is a compact 32px-high control with a 4px radius, not a large pill.

documentationShell.desktop: 56px full-width header above a left navigation, central reading area and right outline.
documentationShell.mobile: Full-width header and single reading column; secondary sidebars are absent.
documentationShell.density: Dense navigation and long-form technical reading remain separate zones.

contentHierarchy.recipe: Lead with 36px/700 H1, then preserve a wide monospaced technical-flow surface as the Introduction's dominant explanatory graphic. Continue with dense prose, layer explanation and multiple 24px/600 H2 sections so the page retains a long-form title-to-model-to-detail rhythm.

buttonReference.recipe: Retain the technical-document progression title → purpose → import → multiple live preview/code modules → API → theme variables. Expose at least two independently reviewable sections; one must prove preview/code structure and another must prove downstream reference density.
notFor: generic component gallery without code or reference material

currentPageNavigation.recipe: Use rgb(88, 84, 255) text over the observed pale-purple 8px-radius row treatment.

primaryButton.recipe: Use white text on rgb(124, 102, 255), 32px height and 4px radius; preserve compact control density.

interactionRecipes.scope: Normal Primary Button on frozen Button page

assetRoleBoundaries.rule: The frozen pages are primarily DOM/CSS documentation compositions. The header logomark/text may be reconstructed as a documented shell identity, but no captured screenshot may be used as a runtime asset.
assetRoleBoundaries.inventoryFinding: The rendered inventory is dominated by icon-font and network-resource candidates; none is promoted as a high-salience composition asset for this scope.

unresolvedClaims.reason: #F7F7F9 is visible in the technical diagram claim, but the frozen claim does not bind that exact background value to its own visible DOM selector as a promoted reusable semantic role.
unresolvedClaims.impact: Use a restrained light supporting surface structurally, but do not publish #F7F7F9 as a general surface token from this run.

unresolvedClaims.reason: Orange exists as a candidate in extracted code/theme data but has no high-salience rendered role on the frozen Introduction and Primary Button evidence.
unresolvedClaims.impact: Orange is not a DangoUI core accent or action color in this scope.

unresolvedClaims.reason: The frozen rendered claim proves title sizes and weights but does not establish one exact custom family as a system-wide brand invariant.
unresolvedClaims.impact: Use readable system sans hierarchy; do not claim a proprietary brand face.

unresolvedClaims.reason: Only the normal Primary Button state sequence was captured and validated.
unresolvedClaims.impact: Do not extrapolate secondary, outline, disabled, loading or destructive button behavior.

unresolvedClaims.reason: The source capture visibly shows the fixed header occluding the first title, but this is treated as an observed source defect rather than desired brand behavior.
unresolvedClaims.impact: Do not encode the overlap as an invariant; the design direction must explicitly decide whether a calibration demo reproduces or corrects it and disclose the choice.
